Secret Rare.name: Blade Knight
Secret Rare.desc: Gains 400 ATK while you have 1 or less cards in your hand. If you control no other monsters, the effects of Flip monsters destroyed by battle with this card are negated.

Secret Rare.name: Command Knight
Secret Rare.desc: All Warrior monsters you control gain 400 ATK. If you control another monster, monsters your opponent controls cannot target this card for attacks.

Secret Rare.name: Insect Queen
Secret Rare.desc: This card gains 200 ATK for each Insect monster on the field. Cannot declare an attack unless you Tribute 1 monster. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card destroyed an opponent's monster by battle this turn: Special Summon 1 "Insect Monster Token" (Insect/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) in Attack Position.

Secret Rare.name: Obnoxious Celtic Guard
Secret Rare.desc: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 1900 or more ATK.

Secret Rare.name: Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight
Secret Rare.desc: If this is the only card in your hand, you can Normal Summon it without Tributing.

Secret Rare.name: Total Defense Shogun
Secret Rare.desc: This card is changed to Defense Position when it is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned successfully. This card can attack while it is in Defense Position. If this card attacks while in Defense Position, apply the ATK of this card for damage calculation.
